name: lying ab press
description: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
